author: kodareef5
message:
music: a prototype to hear in a browser: one dark symphonic metal track in four intensities, and a lab page that moves between them on the bar

- assets/source/core/music/dread/: calm, tense, combat and climax (D minor, 96 BPM, 2 minutes, stereo Opus at
  128 kb/s, about 1.9 MB each) and a demo walk-through, with each layer's recipe (prompt, seed, model, revision).
  Made with Stable Audio 3 Medium on CUDA: the base from its prompt, each further layer from the base as its starting
  audio, so all keep its bars and key. Each takes about 5 s to make on an RTX 4070 Laptop.
- assets/source/core/music/listen.html: open it from the folder in a browser. Play all four in sync and switch
  intensity; a change waits for the next bar and crossfades over two, as the music director will.
- tools/sound/music.py (layers from a music brief, pinned revisions, the render lock held for the run) and
  music_demo.py (Opus and the demo mix), and the brief.

For listening only; not for merging until the owner has heard it.

author: kodareef5
message:
art: figs lifted into a broad dome over a vase, banyans' roof dense, clumps of sun and shade leaves

The figs' crowns stand from 5.4 to 6.2 m up, a broad low dome over limbs in a vase, their undersides closed; what
they swallowed shows through wider windows, the column under a larger capital, the pole broken off high among the
limbs with its crossarm, two street blades across the sign's post. The banyans' lobes are thicker and their roof
closed beneath, a layered ceiling over the beams. A crown's surface is smoothed once found, its large faces shrink
the skin onto them, and each clump wears sun or shade leaves whole, so the change falls in the creases between
clumps. More fringe cards along the outline. Budgets for the elders and figs: 60,000, 16,000 and 3,000 triangles
for the levels with pictures.

author: kodareef5
message:
art: broadleaf crowns as one opaque surface with a fringe of cut-out leaves, and young trees of their own

A phone in a dense wood paid for every layer of cut-out leaf a pixel looked through. A crown is now the outside
of the union of its billows' clumps (canopy.py, surface nets on a grid set by the level), opaque, wearing its
kind's crown skin (artist's set in tex/crown_skins/, composed by crowns.py with sun leaves above and shade leaves
below, the figs' swallowed things and the mangroves' roots sharing its picture so no level needs a fourth
material); only a fringe of half clusters stands out along its outer side. The flat levels are the same surface
over gathered masses. Oak crowns are fuller, their undersides closed into a ceiling.

core:tree's meshes are four young live oaks of their own (young.py: a slim stem clear to 2.9 to 3.4 m, three or
four light limbs, a rounder crown, 10 to 13 m); the elders are core:oak_1 to 3. Elder oaks' boxes reach up the
trunk to 2.6 m and along the foot of each great limb above 2 m. wood.ts counts a wood's cut-out layers; gpu.ts
draws trees on a GPU with shadows through the lit probe's page.
